profile.headline: Software Engineer in Test: Automation, Performance, Reliability
profile.summary:
A data-driven, passionate Software Engineer in Test with experience driving holistic solutions from idea
inception and specification development through commercial deployment. Experienced in managing
distributed development and QA teams, some operating in international environments, and coordinating
a diverse series of deliverables including cloud integration, web application development, firmware
integration and hardware collaboration. Knowledgeable across multiple programming languages and
development strategies. Experienced in voice of customer facilitation and on-site customer system
deployment. Seasoned in international travel and coordination.
